open: Google's client secret and Terraform state: Cognito's Google provider (aws_cognito_identity_provider) takes client_secret in provider_details, which has no write-only form, so Terraform would store it in state, against ARCHITECTURE 14 and MA-159 (no secret ever in state). Settle how it reaches Cognito: accept it in the encrypted state bucket as the one exception, or set it outside a Terraform resource.
